data.body: RCA/TDD evidence: compose already had a structural guard for FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS='*', but the autodeploy mcp_run_new docker-run path had no equivalent oracle, so deleting or weakening the flag would not be caught even though autodeploy is the production deploy path. RED: after adding the scoped mcp_run_new test, deleting the -e FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS='*' line failed the new test; changing the value to 172.17.0.1 also failed it. GREEN: restored the existing committed autodeploy value and tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py::test_autodeploy_mcp_run_new_trusts_the_edge_forwarded_proto passes; the full unit file passes (62 passed). Domain review: test-only guard, scoped through _mcp_run_new_body(), no new mechanism or production behavior.
